thread:
maria: Heads up 60; dashboard perf regression after telemetry rewrite. Charts take longer to respond on first interaction (hover/legend toggle). Noticed after last night's canary.

sam: I can repro on /dashboards/usage (eu). Main thread spike ~600ms on first hover.

lee: Which bundle change? Any new large deps?

maria: Diff shows telemetry moved to analytics module and now it's statically imported by root layout. Bundle gzip up ~28KB, parse time increased.

alex: Profile indicates `window.__REDWOOD_TELEMETRY.init` executing during module evaluation. That explains blocking. We should avoid sync init during module load.

nora: We intentionally rolled telemetry in for immediate crash reporting, but maybe we can lazy-init on user interaction.

sam: Proposed hotfix: change `import './telemetry'` to `void import('./telemetry').then(m => m.init())` behind a small debounce after firstPaint. Also remove `readSourceMapSync()` which slipped in via dev util ".

karen: Also check telemetry's dependency on uuid-polyfill; that added ~12KB. Could polyfill be replaced with lightweight id gen?

lee: I'll craft a canary with dynamic import + polyfill removal. If hover freeze drops we roll.

deploy-bot: deploy: telemetry-fix-pr -> eu canary (1699999999) :rocket:

maria: Quick metrics: canary users reported interaction-blocking 75th=220ms -> 90th=480ms. After fix we want to see 90th back under 300ms.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4831 (dynamic import + remove sync call). Includes a feature flag `telemetry.lazyInit=true` for rollback.

alex: Add unit test ensuring telemetry doesn't run during module evaluation and e2e check that toggling legend doesn't call telemetry init synchronously.

nora: Also add ops dashboard alert if telemetry init time >200ms so we catch regressions.

lee: Running canary perf test now, will post flamegraph in 5m.

maria: Thanks. If it helps, we could also gate heavy collectors behind `navigator.sendBeacon` queue flush rather than running parsers on main thread.

lee: Flamegraph: main thread parse block reduced from ~450ms to ~90ms after dynamic import. Hover stutter essentially gone in my local.

maria: Awesome. Let's monitor canary for an hour then roll. Add rollback steps if error rate >0.5% or hover latency 90th >350ms.

sam: Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: rollout: telemetry-fix-pr -> eu 100% (1700000605) :white_check_mark:

karen: Follow-up: open ENG-4945 to evaluate replacing uuid-polyfill with crypto.randomUUID or tiny ID generator.

alex: I'll update the rollout doc and note telemetry lazy-init as umbrella for future rollouts.

maria: Nice work team :tada:
